issues.title: Missing Per-Artifact Spec Files
issues.why: The module references 79 external spec files (e.g., 01-check-spec-cross-links.md) which are not provided in the context. A mediocre AI cannot implement the toolchain logic (the actual script behaviors) without these individual specs.
issues.fix: Provide the content of the referenced NN-*.md files or merge their core logic into the overview.

issues.title: Delegated Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-T-29 explicitly delegates per-script logic to external files. Without these, the AI has no Given/When/Then criteria for the actual script behaviors, only module-level meta-rules.
issues.fix: Incorporate the GWT criteria for the most critical scripts (01, 05, 14, 34) directly into 97-acceptance-criteria.md.

issues.title: Concurrency/Locking Implementation Ambiguity
issues.why: R2 requires retries on JSONDecodeError to handle 'torn reads', but doesn't specify if this applies to all readers or just specific slots, and lacks a code example for the retry logic.
issues.fix: Add a normative code snippet for the R2 retry pattern in the overview, mirroring the R1 atomic-write example.
